scripts.text:
[Elven Ears Quest]
Hi, today's quest is....
Ah, the ^61B031Elven Ears ^000000Quest!
scripts.translation:
[精灵之耳任务]
你好，今天的任务是...
啊，就是^61B031精灵之耳^000000任务！

scripts.text:
[Elven Ears quest]
Good good, let me just check
scripts.translation:
[精灵之耳任务]
好的好的，让我先确认一下

scripts.text:
[Elven Ears quest]
Give me a second.....

scripts.translation:
[精灵之耳任务]
好了，完成了！

scripts.text:
[Elven Ears Quest]
You don't have the requirements.
Please come back another time...
scripts.translation:
[精灵之耳任务]
您不满足任务要求。
请改天再来吧...

scripts.text:
[Elven Ears Quest]
Ok all you have to do is collect:
^362ED61 Kitty Band^000000
^362ED620 Elder Pixie Mustaches^000000
and ^362ED620 Animal Skin^000000
scripts.translation:
[精灵之耳任务]
好的，您只需要收集：
^362ED61个猫耳发圈^000000
^362ED620个长老的胡子^000000
以及^362ED620张动物外皮^000000

scripts.text:
[Elven Ears Quest]
When you are done, bring the items to me.  Ok good luck finding those items.
scripts.translation:
[精灵之耳任务]
收集完成后，把物品交给我。好的，祝您收集顺利。

[精灵之耳任务]
也许改天再来？

scripts.text:
[Elven Ears quest]
Aw, what a shame
Giving up already?
Oh well maybe you will participate in tomorrow's quest.
scripts.translation:
[精灵之耳任务]
哎呀，真可惜
这就放弃了吗？
好吧，也许您会参加明天的任务。
